answer: A work-credit ledger lets each agent earn influence only by completing verifiable tasks that independent peers attest, so a fresh identity starts with no power. Credits decay steadily, like a meadow that must be tended, so stockpiled Sybils cannot strike later. A beacon service publishes the current credit rules and audit trail, while a trellis of cross-checks links every task to its verifier, exposing forged attestations when one verifier vouches for too many strangers. Spinning up thousands of fake agents buys nothing, because each must still perform real, checked work to gain any voice.
